annotation.title_clean: 自然资源部关于加快测绘地理信息事业转型升级 更好支撑高质量发展的意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions of the Ministry of Natural Resources on Accelerating the Transformation and Upgrading of Surveying, Mapping and Geoinformation to Better Support High-Quality Development
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 自然资源部 (Ministry of Natural Resources of China)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Natural Resources of China
annotation.summary_en: China's Ministry of Natural Resources issues opinions on transforming surveying, mapping and geoinformation: building a new basic surveying system and real-scene 3D China, treating geodata as a production factor, strengthening geoinformation security supervision, and standards. Mentions AI, autonomous driving and emergency drones only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Targets for 2025 and 2030: new basic surveying system, real-scene 3D China, Tianditu platform
Establish classified and graded protection for geographic data and a negative list for data circulation
Adjust management policies for AI, autonomous driving and crowdsourced mapping; conduct security assessments of new technologies
Develop standards for geospatial data, security and digital economy applications
Explore data property registration and trading, and multi-source investment
